scriptError.message:
There is an error in the game handler {file}.

The game this handler is for will not appear in the list. If the issue has been fixed,
please try re-adding the game.

Common errors include:
- A syntax error (such as a ',' ';' or ']' missing)
- Another handler has this GUID (must be unique!)
- Code is not in the right place or format
(for example: methods using Context must be within the Game.Play function)

{details}

help.fileNotFound:
Nucleus Co-op can't find the game's configuration file, make sure you ran your main game at least once without Nucleus and that you changed some graphic settings and applied them, that way you make sure the proper configuration files got generated.
If you are still getting this error after doing that, select the game in the Nucleus Co-op user interface, click on Game Options and select Delete UserProfile Config Path for all players. You can also try deleting Nucleus Co-op content folder and adding the game again.
help.access:
Nucleus Co-op doesn't have the necessary permissions or is trying to access a file that is already in use,
a file could be missing (For helpers: in case of "IOException" check if all required files from "Game.Play = function()" exist.)
please make sure Nucleus Co-op is outside any game files or protected folders,
placing Nucleus Co-op app folder in the root of your main drive is recommended to avoid permission issues: {suggestedFolder}.
Make sure other apps are not using any of the files Nucleus is trying to access. If all else fails run Nucleus Co-op with admin rights.
